keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_PORT
keys.description: HTTP and WebSocket listen port of the proxy.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_METRICS_PORT
keys.description: Prometheus metrics port of the proxy.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_READ_TIMEOUT
keys.description: HTTP server read timeout.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_READ_HEADER_TIMEOUT
keys.description: HTTP server read-header timeout.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_WRITE_TIMEOUT
keys.description: HTTP server write timeout. 0 means per-route deadlines apply instead (M12): /api, /v1 (upstream timeout + 30 s) and KB upload (ingest timeout + 30 s).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
keys.description: Graceful shutdown limit for the HTTP server.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_TIMEOUT
keys.description: How long shutdown waits for queued deep audits to drain (M6).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_LOG_LEVEL
keys.description: Log level.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_ENV_FILE
keys.description: Dotenv file to load. auto: Go walks up to the directory containing VERSION and uses its .env; Python loads repo_root/.env then ./.env. An empty value disables dotenv loading. The loader never overwrites a variable that is already set.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_STRICT_CONFIG
keys.description: Exit with code 2 on any configuration warning (invalid value or unknown TRUTHTABLE_* key). CI and e2e set it.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_DATA_DIR
keys.description: Proxy data directory; holds secret.key.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_PUBLIC_URL
keys.description: Public dashboard URL: base of the OpenRouter PKCE callback, the cookie Secure default and the CSRF origin.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_TRUSTED_PROXIES
keys.default_note: compose sets the internal network CIDR
keys.description: CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted for client IPs (M8, C-M21). Empty trusts none.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
keys.description: Allowed browser origins for CORS and WebSocket.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_DEMO_MODE
keys.description: Demo mode: forces the mock decision model and labels every surface as simulated.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_READONLY
keys.description: Public read-only instance: every write endpoint is refused.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_PUBLIC_READ
keys.description: Allow reads without a key (auth.read = public).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_TEST_MODE
keys.description: Honour test_response and X-TrustAgent-Scenario. Without it, test_response returns 400 test_mode_disabled (M7).

keys.name: BIND_ADDR
keys.description: Host address every published compose port binds to.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_INGEST_AUTH
keys.description: Who may send /v1 traffic: keys (an ingest key is required) or open. open is refused while an upstream credential is injected.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_API_KEYS
keys.description: Env API keys as label=key,...; scopes ingest + read + content.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_READ_KEYS
keys.description: Env API keys with the read scope only.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_ADMIN_KEYS
keys.description: Env API keys with every scope. Admin keys never change the ingest/read auth mode.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SECRET_KEY
keys.description: Master key (base64, 32 bytes) for credential encryption and sessions. Otherwise read from TRUTHTABLE_SECRET_KEY_FILE, otherwise generated there.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SECRET_KEY_FILE
keys.description: Where the master key is read from or generated (mode 0600, directory 0700).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SESSION_TTL
keys.description: Dashboard session lifetime. Sessions slide for 30 days when TRUTHTABLE_PUBLIC_URL is localhost.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SETUP_TOKEN_TTL
keys.description: Lifetime of the one-time setup token.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SETUP_TOKEN
keys.description: Seeds the one-time setup token instead of generating one.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_COOKIE_SECURE
keys.description: Secure flag on session cookies. auto = true when TRUTHTABLE_PUBLIC_URL is https.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_INTERNAL_TOKEN
keys.description: Shared token for proxy -> engine RPCs (metadata x-trustagent-internal). The proxy generates it when unset; the engine reads it.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_INTERNAL_TOKEN_FILE
keys.description: File holding the internal token (proxy writes, engine reads).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_KEY_DECISION_USD_DAY
keys.description: Optional per-API-key daily decision spend cap in USD. 0 = off.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_UPSTREAM_URL
keys.description: Default upstream for OpenAI-format requests. Empty = https://api.openai.com.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_UPSTREAM_API_KEY
keys.description: Upstream credential. Setting it enables inject mode: client credentials are stripped and this one is sent on TRUTHTABLE_UPSTREAM_AUTH_HEADER.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_UPSTREAM_AUTH_HEADER
keys.description: Header that carries the injected upstream credential.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_ANTHROPIC_UPSTREAM_URL
keys.description: Upstream for Anthropic Messages requests.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_ANTHROPIC_UPSTREAM_API_KEY
keys.description: Injected credential for the Anthropic upstream.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_FALLBACK_UPSTREAM_URL
keys.description: Upstream used by fallback.upstream: fallback. Empty = no fallback upstream.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_FALLBACK_UPSTREAM_API_KEY
keys.description: Credential for the fallback upstream.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_FALLBACK_UPSTREAM_FORMAT
keys.description: API format of the fallback upstream; a mismatch with the request degrades to block (fallback_format_mismatch).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_UPSTREAM_HEADER_TIMEOUT
keys.description: Time to the upstream response headers.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT
keys.description: Total upstream request timeout.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT
keys.description: Maximum gap between upstream stream events.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_MAX_UPSTREAM_RESPONSE_BYTES
keys.description: Largest upstream body the proxy gates (8 MiB). Larger bodies pass through with Status skipped:upstream_error.

keys.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
keys.description: Ollama endpoint: the ollama upstream shorthand and the local judge.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE
keys.description: Requests per minute per key (else per client IP).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_UPLOAD_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE
keys.description: Knowledge uploads per minute per key.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_MAX_BODY_BYTES
keys.description: Largest accepted request body (1 MiB); larger returns 413.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
keys.description: Largest accepted knowledge upload (10 MiB).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_MAX_TEXT_CHARS
keys.description: Largest direct-audit text, counted in runes.

keys.name: REDIS_URL
keys.description: Redis for shared rate limiting (redis profile). Empty = in-memory limiter.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_DATABASE_URL
keys.default_note: compose sets it to the postgres service
keys.description: PostgreSQL URL (>= 14). Empty = in-memory only (dashboard edits apply until restart).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_RETENTION_DAYS
keys.description: Days traces, decisions and audits are kept.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_COST_RETENTION_DAYS
keys.description: Days cost events are kept.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_BODY_RETENTION
keys.description: How long stored request and response bodies are kept.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_BODY_MAX_BYTES
keys.description: Largest body stored per trace.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_LABEL_SAMPLE_RETENTION
keys.description: How long bodies of labelled samples are kept for calibration (90 days).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_TRACE_FLUSH
keys.description: Trace writer mode. sync writes before responding (tests).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_GRPC_ADDRESS
keys.description: Audit engine gRPC address (host:port).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_GRPC_TIMEOUT
keys.description: Deadline of one Evaluate call.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_INGEST_TIMEOUT
keys.description: Deadline of a knowledge ingest call.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_WORKER_COUNT
keys.description: Deep-audit workers. Warns when above the engine max_audits.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_QUEUE_SIZE
keys.description: Low-lane deep-audit queue capacity.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_AUDIT_QUEUE_HIGH
keys.description: High-lane deep-audit queue capacity.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_AUDIT_HIGH_PER_MIN
keys.description: Token bucket for the high lane; overflow goes to the low lane.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_UNIFORM_AUDITS_PER_DAY
keys.description: Daily cap on uniform-sample deep audits; sampling stops for the day once reached.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_ENGINE_HEALTH_INTERVAL
keys.description: Engine health ping interval (M4).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_WS_MAX_CLIENTS
keys.description: Maximum concurrent WebSocket clients.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_WS_MAX_PER_IP
keys.description: Maximum WebSocket clients per IP.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_WS_REPLAY_BUFFER
keys.description: Events kept in the replay ring for resync.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_WS_REPLAY_MAX_BYTES
keys.description: Byte cap of the replay ring (64 MiB).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_WS_HEARTBEAT
keys.description: WebSocket heartbeat interval.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_POLICY_FILE
keys.description: Policy file (schema policy/v1).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_POLICY_RELOAD_INTERVAL
keys.description: Policy file poll interval. 0 disables polling.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_CONFIG_LOCK
keys.description: Make the policy file the only authority: dashboard policy edits are refused (423).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_EVALUATORS_DIR
keys.description: Directory of custom evaluator files (evaluator/v1).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_CALIBRATION_DIR
keys.description: Directory of calibration files (trustagent.calibration/v1).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_CALIBRATION_FAMILY_FALLBACK
keys.description: Use a calibration of the same snapshot family when the exact snapshot has none (forced to provisional).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_GATE_DEFAULT_MODE
keys.description: Seeds defaults.mode when the policy file omits it.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_GATE_FAIL_MODE
keys.description: Seeds defaults.fail when the policy file omits it.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_GATE_MAX_CONCURRENCY
keys.description: Concurrent asynchronous gates; overflow is skipped:overload (detectors still run).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_KNOWLEDGE_ENABLED
keys.description: Enable the knowledge add-on (evidence source knowledge).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_KNOWLEDGE_DEADLINE
keys.description: Default for evidence.knowledge.deadline_ms.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_DECISION_PROVIDER
keys.description: Decision model family. Reserved for another backend family.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_BACKEND
keys.description: Fast-check backend. auto: demo -> mock; base URL + TRUTHTABLE_JEV_API_KEY -> compatible; OpenRouter key -> openrouter-decisions; TypeSafe key -> typesafe; otherwise off.

keys.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
keys.description: One OpenRouter key powers the fast check and the judge.

keys.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
keys.description: TypeSafe direct API key (backend typesafe).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_API_KEY
keys.description: Credential for an explicit backend or compatible only; never applied to the auto-selected vendor backends.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_API_KEY_FILE
keys.description: File holding TRUTHTABLE_JEV_API_KEY.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MODEL
keys.default_note: openrouter-*: typesafe/jev-1.13; typesafe: jev-1.13.0; compatible: required; mock: mock/jev-heuristic-v1
keys.description: Decision model id. ~typesafe/jev-latest and jev-latest are allowed with a warning (thresholds are tuned per version).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_BASE_URL
keys.description: Decision endpoint base URL; https only (http for localhost). Used for compatible, or for vendor backends when set explicitly.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_PATH
keys.description: Decision endpoint path appended to the base URL.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_OPENROUTER_BASE_URL
keys.description: OpenRouter base for PKCE, key checks, backends and the judge; tests point it at mock-upstream.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT
keys.description: Per-attempt timeout. Each attempt runs detached with this timeout; a synchronous gate stops waiting at the route deadline, and an attempt still running then may finish as a late decision (never enforced).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_ASYNC_DEADLINE
keys.description: Deadline for observe gates and late decisions.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MAX_RETRIES
keys.description: Retries of a synchronous decision call.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MAX_RETRIES_ASYNC
keys.description: Retries of an asynchronous decision call.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_RETRY_AFTER_CAP
keys.description: Longest Retry-After honoured.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_GATE_JEV_RPM
keys.description: Decision calls per minute (below the vendor 1,200 RPM).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_GATE_JEV_SYNC_RESERVE
keys.description: Share of the rate limit reserved for synchronous gates.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_GATE_JEV_MAX_INFLIGHT
keys.description: Concurrent decision calls.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_TOKEN_BUDGET
keys.description: Token budget of one decision request (SPEC §2.9 budget.tokens).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_CHARS_PER_TOKEN
keys.description: Initial characters-per-token estimate (cpt); EWMA-corrected at runtime.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MAX_QUESTIONS_PER_CALL
keys.description: Questions per decision request before splitting.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MAX_RESPONSE_TOKENS
keys.description: Seeds decision.max_response_tokens; longer responses are not assessed (too_long).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_BREAKER_FAILURES
keys.description: Consecutive vendor faults that open the circuit breaker.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_BREAKER_COOLDOWN
keys.description: How long the breaker stays open.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_AUTH_COOLDOWN
keys.description: Pause after an authentication failure.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_PRICE_PER_MTOK
keys.description: Override of the decision input price in USD per million tokens.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_APP_URL
keys.description: OpenRouter attribution header HTTP-Referer.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_APP_TITLE
keys.description: OpenRouter attribution header X-Title.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_ZDR
keys.description: Request zero data retention routing on OpenRouter.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_SEND_SESSION_ID
keys.description: Send the trace id as session_id.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_STARTUP_PROBE
keys.description: Send one tiny probe question at startup to verify the backend.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_KEEPALIVE
keys.description: Keep-warm interval while a synchronous route exists.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_LOG_PAYLOADS
keys.description: Log decision request and response bodies (keys are never logged).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MOCK_MODE
keys.description: Mock backend mode: scenario answers from contracts demo scenarios (mock_answers); hash gives deterministic hash-based answers; heuristic gives lexical heuristics.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MOCK_STRICT
keys.description: Fail instead of falling back when a scenario has no mock answer.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MOCK_FIXTURES
keys.description: Scenario file for the mock backend.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MOCK_SEED
keys.description: Seed of the mock backend.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JEV_MOCK_LATENCY
keys.description: Simulated mock latency. Faults are e2e-only, through mock-upstream.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SPEND_CAP_DECISION_USD_DAY
keys.description: Daily fast-check spend cap in USD; seeds the runtime budget. 0 = unlimited. Past the cap, observe/flag routes skip (degraded: budget), fail-open routes pass and fail-closed block routes block.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SPEND_CAP_LLM_USD_DAY
keys.description: Daily deep-audit (LLM judge) spend cap in USD; seeds the runtime budget. 0 = unlimited. The cap is hard in every lane.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SPEND_ENFORCING_RESERVE
keys.description: Share of the decision cap reserved for enforcing routes: observe and flag routes stop at 75% of the cap.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_PRICE_TABLE_FILE
keys.description: Price table override (schema pricing.v1).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_STUDIO_CONFIRM_ABOVE_USD
keys.description: Studio asks for confirmation above this estimated cost.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_DRYRUN_MAX_SAMPLES
keys.description: Largest Studio dry-run sample.

keys.name: LLM_PROVIDER
keys.description: Deep-audit judge. auto: explicit > Anthropic key > OpenRouter key > OpenAI key > Ollama (if reachable) > none; mock in demo mode.

keys.name: LLM_MODEL
keys.default_note: per provider: anthropic claude-haiku-4-5, openrouter OPENROUTER_JUDGE_MODEL, ollama OLLAMA_FALLBACK_MODEL
keys.description: Judge model.

keys.name: LLM_FALLBACK
keys.description: Explicit opt-in fallback judge; reported, never hidden.

keys.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
keys.description: Anthropic key for the judge.

keys.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
keys.description: OpenAI key for the judge.

keys.name: OPENROUTER_JUDGE_MODEL
keys.description: Judge model when the judge runs through OpenRouter.

keys.name: OLLAMA_FALLBACK_MODEL
keys.description: Ollama judge model.

keys.name: MOCK_FIXTURES_PATH
keys.default_note: empty uses the embedded contracts demo scenarios
keys.description: Mock judge fixtures (LLM_PROVIDER=mock).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_JUDGE_MAX_INFLIGHT
keys.description: Process-wide concurrent judge calls.

keys.name: VERIFIER_CONCURRENCY
keys.description: Concurrent claim verifications per audit.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_ANTHROPIC_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS
keys.description: Use Anthropic structured outputs. auto disables them once when the API rejects the parameter.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_VERIFIER
keys.description: Claim verifier. auto = llm in 2.0.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_VERIFY_CONTEXT_SCOPE
keys.description: Evidence given to each claim verification.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_AUDIT_EXTRACT_CLAIMS_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE
keys.description: Decompose answers even without evidence; the claims come back NOT_CHECKED.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SCORING_PARTIAL_WEIGHT
keys.description: Weight of PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED claims in scoring.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SCORING_CONTRADICTION_FLAG
keys.description: Contradiction threshold for HALLUCINATED.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SCORING_UNSUPPORTED_FLAG
keys.description: Unsupported threshold for HALLUCINATED.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SCORING_UNSUPPORTED_FRACTION_FLAG
keys.description: Unsupported-claim fraction for HALLUCINATED.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SCORING_MIN_COVERAGE
keys.description: Minimum decided-claim coverage for a verdict.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SCORING_MAX_UNKNOWN_FRACTION
keys.description: UNKNOWN claim fraction at or above which the audit FAILS (judge_unavailable).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_SCORING_GRADE_CUTOFFS
keys.description: trust_score cutoffs for grades A/B/C/D.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_UNSUPPORTED_POLICY
keys.description: Whether UNSUPPORTED claims count as hallucination or as unverifiable.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_MAX_CLAIMS
keys.description: Most claims decomposed per answer.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_RETRIEVER_TOP_K
keys.description: Knowledge hits per claim (knowledge add-on only).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_RETRIEVER_SCORE_THRESHOLD
keys.description: Minimum knowledge hit score (knowledge add-on only).

keys.name: QDRANT_URL
keys.description: Vector store URL (knowledge add-on only).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_EMBEDDING_MODEL
keys.description: Embedding model (knowledge add-on only).

keys.name: GRPC_HOST
keys.description: Engine gRPC bind host. The engine refuses a non-loopback address without an internal token.

keys.name: GRPC_PORT
keys.description: Engine gRPC port.

keys.name: METRICS_PORT
keys.description: Engine Prometheus metrics port.

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_ENGINE_MAX_RPCS
keys.description: Concurrent engine RPCs (C-H13).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_ENGINE_MAX_AUDITS
keys.description: Concurrent audits (C-H13); reported to the proxy as max_audits.

keys.name: LOG_LEVEL
keys.description: Engine log level.

keys.name: LANGSMITH_API_KEY
keys.description: LangSmith tracing key.

keys.name: LANGSMITH_PROJECT
keys.description: LangSmith project.

keys.name: LANGSMITH_TRACING
keys.description: Enable LangSmith tracing (needs LANGSMITH_API_KEY).

keys.name: TRUTHTABLE_CONTRACTS_DIR
keys.description: Where the engine reads contracts/. auto walks up to contracts/, then /app/contracts (the image copies it there).

keys.name: COMPOSE_PROFILES
keys.description: Optional compose add-ons.

keys.name: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME
keys.description: Compose project name.

keys.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
keys.default_note: generated by configure --ensure when .env is new; never changed once the volume exists
keys.description: Postgres password.

keys.name: GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD
keys.description: Grafana admin password (observability profile).

keys.name: PROXY_HOST_PORT
keys.description: Host port of the proxy.

keys.name: DASHBOARD_HOST_PORT
keys.description: Host port of the dashboard.

keys.name: POSTGRES_HOST_PORT
keys.description: Host port of Postgres.

keys.name: TRUSTAGENT_VERSION
keys.description: Image tag of the app services.

keys.name: ENGINE_EXTRAS
keys.description: Engine image build extras; knowledge installs the knowledge-base dependencies.

keys.name: TRAFFICGEN_API_KEY
keys.description: Ingest key used by the demo traffic generator.

keys.name: MOCK_UPSTREAM_ADDR
keys.description: Listen address of mock-upstream, the fake of every vendor API the e2e and load stacks use (compose profiles e2e and load). The -addr flag overrides it.

keys.name: DASHBOARD_API_BASE
keys.description: API base written to /config.json. Empty = same origin.

keys.name: DASHBOARD_WS_URL
keys.description: WebSocket URL written to /config.json.

keys.name: DASHBOARD_PROXY_UPSTREAM
keys.description: nginx proxy_pass target for /api, /v1, /ws and /health.

keys.name: DASHBOARD_CONNECT_SRC
keys.description: Extra CSP connect-src entries.

keys.name: VITE_APP_MODE
keys.description: Frontend build: the full dashboard or the static GitHub Pages site.

keys.name: VITE_BASE_PATH
keys.description: Base path of the build (Pages: /TrustAgent/).

keys.name: VITE_DEMO_DATASET
keys.description: Replay dataset of the static build.

keys.name: VITE_REPLAY_SPEED
keys.description: Replay speed multiplier of the static build.

keys.name: VITE_PLAYGROUND_MAX_CALLS
keys.description: Static in-browser playground call cap (Studio drafts included).

keys.name: VITE_PLAYGROUND_MAX_TOKENS
keys.description: Static in-browser playground token cap per call.

keys.name: VITE_JEV_MODEL
keys.description: Decision model used by the static playground.

keys.name: VITE_OPENROUTER_JUDGE_MODEL
keys.description: Judge and drafter model used by the static site.

keys.name: VITE_REPO_URL
keys.description: Repository link.
